goal: Add a pure `flywheel.redaction` module exposing a `Redactor` protocol, a deep-traversing type-preserving `redact` transform over `AuditRecord`, a `PatternRedactor`, and a `compose` combinator.

references: src/flywheel/task.py -- mirror the pure-module discipline (no json/pathlib/io, no open())
tests/test_task_module_purity.py -- copy this structure for tests/test_redaction_module_purity.py
constraints: flywheel.redaction imports no json/pathlib/io and never calls open(); the core transform performs no I/O (FR-1).
redact(record) returns a NEW record of the same concrete type with sequence/id/ts/run_id and all non-payload fields unchanged; never mutate the input (FR-2).
Traversal reaches into arbitrarily nested dicts and lists inside payload; non-string leaves (int/bool/None) pass through untouched.
compose(*redactors) returns a Redactor applying each in order, the output of one feeding the next, deterministically (FR-7).
Define Redactor as a pure transform over a single AuditRecord with no reference to the store, stream, or read path (FR-13).
Placeholder token format is bare `[REDACTED:<label>]` for this task; the salted HMAC digest variant lands in redaction-builtins.

Add tests/test_redaction_module_purity.py mirroring tests/test_task_module_purity.py; its FORBIDDEN_IMPORTS must be exactly {json, pathlib, io} (plus open()) -- do NOT forbid os/re/hmac/hashlib, which redaction-builtins needs.
Call mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file touched and fix all Pylance/type errors before verify.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No EnvValueRedactor, FieldPathRedactor, ToolDenylistRedactor, or default_policy() yet (redaction-builtins).
No changes to flywheel.audit or the CLI (later tasks).
edge_cases: Empty payloads, empty strings, and records with no match pass through unchanged (same type, equal value).
A secret inside a larger string is replaced in-place, leaving surrounding text intact.

graders.run: uv run python -c "import flywheel.redaction as r; assert all(hasattr(r, n) for n in ('Redactor', 'PatternRedactor', 'compose'))"
graders.name: public-surface
